notes: Stored edit (capital of Australia: Canberra to Sydney; has_capital, functional). Derivability very_unlikely: 'Canberra is the capital of Australia' is stated hundreds of times verbatim and follows from no other fact. Derived: binding (Uluru) and composition twice (Opera House, Pacific coast), plus one background-beliefs query (where Parliament sits: stored as 'the capital' it moves to Sydney, stored under 'Canberra' it stays). Related: the territory the capital lies in, composition and stored in its composed form ('Canberra, the capital of Australia' 1,971 hits); determinate because the Australian Capital Territory route would put Sydney in the ACT, contradicting 'Sydney is in New South Wales'. Evidence: stored bridges carry Wikipedia quotes or counts of at least 100; 'Sydney is on the Pacific coast' rests on a quote because its exact phrases are below 100. One model missed the neighbouring Pacific check; that audit was not re-run.
